en: Black‑and‑white view of a quiet European city street lined with late‑19th‑century townhouses and small trees. The cobblestone road curves gently into the distance. On the left façade, large painted advertising text promotes a business named Paul Weber related to building and water/closet installations. Fenced front gardens and modest urban architecture dominate the scene; there are no cars or people clearly visible.
